title: No access to any client system or contact: the public RPPL page and the Muse CRM sales site are the only external evidence
body: Stated by the author 2026-10-29: there is no access to RPPL, Muse CRM, Adsmovil, Hogarth or any other system built for a client, and no channel to ask those clients anything. What exists publicly is the RPPL page that hosts the map (the `rppl-map` demo link of project `mapas-distritos`) and Muse CRM's marketing site and app (links of `muse-crm`); everything else is what content/data/content.es.json already says. Consequences: do not plan steps like 'ask the client whether X may be shown' or 'get the real numbers from the system'; the landing's RPPL map stays illustrative geometry (src/scripts/v2/map.ts, labelled 'Geometría ilustrativa · los números son reales'), never a copy of the real map's shape; screenshots or media of client work come only from those public pages.
not_derivable: Access to clients and their systems is an external fact; the dataset shows links, not that nothing else can be obtained.

evidence.summary: Author, 2026-10-29: 'No nos dan acceso a rppl ni ningun otro sistema que hayamos hecho... Para RPPL tenes la url que redirige al proyecto y para MuseCRM tenemos la landing. No hay mas que eso.'
